name: Otome 2
source:
Mikio used to be a great alchemist when he was a kid. However, he now lives a boring life. He just works at his father's company every day.... But one day, his life changes all of a sudden. He is ordered to transfer to a different department that is located at the edge of nowhere.... 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081107173954/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011700]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
主人公小时候曾是出色的炼金术士。
然而如今，他过着乏味的生活，每天只在父亲的公司工作……
直到某天，他被命令调往一处偏僻的部门，人生骤然改变……

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081107173954/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011700]Eroge Shop[/url]]
